import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0202 {l : List Nat} : List.length (List.filter (fun x => x < 5) l) ≤ List.length l := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0202 {l : List Nat} : List.length (List.filter (fun x => x < 5) l) ≤ List.length l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs =>
    have h1 : List.length (List.filter (fun x => x < 5) xs) ≤ List.length xs := by
      apply final_dev_0202
    have h2 : List.length (List.filter (fun x => x < 5) (x::xs)) ≤ List.length (x::xs) := by
      simp [List.filter_cons, List.length_cons, List.filter_empty, List.filter_cons, h1]
    exact h2
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0202 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0202 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
